meta.title: Mutabil — moving in Cluj with the price and time known up front
meta.description: Configure your move and see the van, crew, hours, guaranteed window and every price line right away. Reusable crates, assembly, protection.

landing.title: Book your move like a flight.
landing.lead: See the price, the arrival time and what is included — before you call anyone. No haggling on the day.
landing.exact: Or make an exact estimate, 3–5 minutes

journey.title: How it goes
journey.requestText: You configure and send. Free and with no obligation.
journey.surveyText: Photos, video or a visit. Then you get the guaranteed maximum price.
journey.cratesText: Arrive a few days before, if you chose them.
journey.moveText: The crew arrives in the window you picked. You know from the start how long it takes.

faq.title: What happens if…
faq.q1: …there are more things than I said?
faq.a1: The crew lead shows you what changed and what it costs before any extra work starts. Nothing is added without your consent.
faq.q2: …the lift is smaller or out of order?
faq.a2: If you chose “Not sure”, we have already priced a small lift. If there is no working lift at all, we carry by the stairs under the same rules as in the estimate.
faq.a3: The configurator warns you in advance and prices the stairs for that item. Furniture that comes apart travels as panels.
faq.a4: We are liable by law: if something breaks through our fault, we repair it or pay its real value. The crew leader records the problem with you on the spot.
faq.q5: …the crew is late or works longer?
faq.a5: The end of the window is written in the estimate. If we overrun because of us, you do not pay above the cap.
faq.q6: …I don't know the answer to a question?
faq.a6: Choose “Not sure”. You will see right away what we assume and how much the price can change.

gets.title: What you get with Mutabil
gets.lead: Everything that makes a move easy, from one provider. Pick only what you need.
gets.cratesText: We bring them {before} days before and collect them {after} days after. No boxes to buy, no tape to hunt for, nothing to throw away.
gets.wardrobeText: Clothes travel on their hangers, exactly as they hang in the wardrobe. Hang them back on arrival.
gets.mattressText: Your mattress arrives clean, free of dust and marks.
gets.assemblyText: A handyman takes the furniture apart before the move and puts it together on arrival. Your bed is ready on the first night.
gets.packingText: We pack the kitchen and the fragile things, or everything, the day before.
gets.visitText: They come to your home, see what moves and give you a guaranteed maximum price. No surprises on moving day.

care.title: How we take care of your home and things
care.lead: Before the first item leaves, we protect the floor, the doors and the lift. Furniture leaves wrapped and arrives the same way.
care.floorText: Cardboard or film all the way from the room to the door.
care.doorsText: Door frames and lift walls are covered before any furniture passes.
care.furnitureText: Blankets and stretch film on every piece, corners protected.
care.cratesText: Every crate says which room it goes to.
care.vanText: Straps and blankets in the van: nothing moves on the road.
care.crew: A crew with the right tools
care.crewText: Dollies, straps and tools, so we work fast without rushing.
care.note: Photos from our moves will be here. Until then, we describe what you'll see.

ways.title: Two ways to order
ways.lead: Choose every detail yourself, or leave it all to us.
ways.flexWho: For those who want to decide and pay only for what they choose.
ways.flex1: Choose the services and see the price right away
ways.flex2: A survey from photos and video (free) or at your home ({fee} lei, deducted from the order)
ways.flex3: After the survey, a guaranteed maximum price
ways.fullWho: For those who don't want to think about any of it.
ways.full1: A specialist visits your home, free, and plans the move
ways.full2: We bring crates and boxes and pack everything
ways.full3: We take furniture apart and put it back together
ways.full4: Cleaning by our partner, if you want it
ways.full5: A guaranteed maximum price, set at the visit

final.title: See what your move costs

protection.title: Do you want a guaranteed maximum price?
protection.question: How should we survey the move?
protection.lead: Until the survey, the price is a range. After it you get a guaranteed maximum price: you never pay more than the confirmed estimate plus the limit below.
protection.remoteText: Free. Maximum: the confirmed estimate + {pct} %. The estimator may ask for more.
protection.onsiteText: {price} lei, deducted from the order. Maximum: the confirmed estimate + {pct} %.
protection.noneText: You pay for the real time at the published rates. It can cost more if there are more things.
protection.liability: We are liable for your things by law: if something breaks through our fault, we repair it or pay its real value.
protection.disabledByCrates: With reusable crates, the specialist brings the crates and surveys in the same visit.
protection.disabledByAtSurvey: Your things are counted at the survey, so one is needed.
protection.onlyOnsite: With reusable crates, the survey is a visit: the specialist brings the crates and sees what moves in the same visit.

rates.title: How we calculate the price
rates.metaDescription: Mutabil's hourly and per-item rates, what's included at no cost and how an estimate becomes a guaranteed maximum price.
rates.lead: The same rates are behind every estimate on this site. There are no others, and no haggling on the spot.
rates.madeTitle: What the total is made of
rates.made1: The van and the crew, paid by the hour. We estimate the hours from volume, floors, lift and the distance from the door to the van.
rates.made2: The services you choose, per item: crates, boxes, disassembly and assembly, packing.
rates.made4: Basic materials and protection of your home, included at no cost.
rates.cratesPrice: {rate} lei / crate · {days} days included · then {extra} leu / crate / day
rates.includedTitle: Included in every move, at no cost
rates.rangeTitle: From a range to a guaranteed maximum price
rates.range1: Until we see what moves, we show a range: what it would cost in the best and in the worst case.
rates.range2: After the survey you get a guaranteed maximum price: the final bill cannot exceed the confirmed estimate by more than {remote} % after photos and video, or {onsite} % after a specialist visit, as long as the volume and access are as described.
rates.range3: In the "We take care of everything" package the visit is free. Otherwise it costs {fee} lei and is deducted from the order.
rates.overtime: One hour beyond the guaranteed window
rates.overtimeText: van and crew at the same rates, billed per 30 minutes
rates.weekendText: +{pct} %, a separate line in the estimate
rates.promise1: Nothing is added without your consent.
rates.promise2: We never hold your belongings for an extra payment.
rates.promise3: No haggling at the door: the price is the one these rules give.
rates.note: All prices are in lei and include 21 % VAT. The values are being verified.
